Aircraft.Instructions:
Jerboa By: BaconEggs
AG1: Left Doors AG2: Right Doors AG7: Rotor brake
Notes: My main goal with this helicopter was to make the most 'gooberous' little guy possible. Making the Jerby was my first time using the new fuselage. I had great fun finding new methods of building that would've taken so much more time and effort with the old parts. Fair warning, engaging the rotor brake in the air will pull you back to earth before you have the chance to say "oh great heavens".
